newsitem.title: BRAZIL:B Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: B Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Megadaloxi loading 55,000 tonnes soybeans. El Flamenco loading 40,000 tonnes soymeal. Valentina loading 35,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, nine vessels to load soymeal, two to load soybeans and one for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 746 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on July 24, as well as 299 trucks with soymeal and 97 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.

Vessels: At public terminal, Cornilos loading 51,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 12,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Commander loading 67,007 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 60,000 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 78 trucks carrying 2,049 tonnes soybeans arrived on July 24.
Rail: 52 wagons arrived carrying 3,207 tonnes soybeans.
